title: A trading journal I built for discretionary traders (with AI + fundamentals) — feedback welcome
author: Achrestra
selftext:
I've been trading for a while, and one thing I kept struggling with was keeping everything in one place. My fundamental analysis was in one app, my trade journal was somewhere else, and my trading plan was scattered across different notes.

So I started building my own trading journal.

It isn't just a journal. It helps traders:

* Record and review every trade.
* Document the fundamental bias before entering a trade.
* Build and follow a trading plan.
* Use AI agents to help review trades, identify mistakes, and provide insights.
* Track performance over time and improve consistency.

The goal isn't to generate signals or tell people what to trade. It's designed to help discretionary traders make better decisions and stay disciplined.

I'm still developing it and would genuinely appreciate feedback from other Forex traders.

What features do you think are missing from current trading journals? What would make you actually use one every day?
